Messages.Body:
I found this ruling:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/c160a3e36236e260

so I am really just double-checking that this situation applies.

Aye says "If this Laibon burns a minion, equipment, or location in
play, he or she burns one Aye."

If a vampire with Aye calls Eldest Command Undeath, and burns a vampire,
does that acting vampire burn an Aye? By the ruling above, the answer would
seem to be "no".

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct (for the same reason, ECU is not a direction action).
